result.result:
The rule and witnesses for NRS_484B_307_9b_o4 passed the gate with **OK** on the first run (7 witnesses, 17 names, 1 of 6 runs used). I wrote `task_result.md` in the working directory.

**The rule:**
- **Who it covers:** x is any of the five vehicle groups the law names (motorcycle, moped, bicycle, electric bicycle, electric scooter), or anything labelled a motorcycle.
- **When it applies:** it is judged once per crossing, at the moment x leaves the intersection. It applies to:
  - going straight through under a red with either green arrow;
  - a right turn under a green left arrow;
  - a left turn under a green right arrow.

  The signal must have been showing red plus that arrow when x entered. It must have controlled either the lane x was in just before entering or the intersection itself.
- **The duty:** at every moment from entry to exit when x is in the intersection and moving, x must not be on course for a near-collision. That means coming closer than 4 m within the next 3 s, measured centre to centre. The duty covers pedestrians on a crosswalk at the intersection's approaches and any other road user in the intersection.

**Three choices the node left to me:**
- **"The lane just before entry":** the formula language has no way to say "at the previous moment", so I built it from start/stop edges of lane occupancy. It means exactly that.
- **An extra "not the intersection itself" check on the crosswalk's lane:** the data never says which lanes feed into the intersection area itself, so that test comes out undecided there. Without the check, the `blind` witness would be undecided for the wrong reason. The check excludes nothing the node allows, so I explained it in the file header and did not declare it as a narrowing.
- **No narrowings added.**

**Witnesses:** besides the six the node plans, I added `branch_3`, an electric bicycle turning left under a green right arrow, with the signal controlling the intersection itself. Without it, two parts of the formula (the left-turn case and the signal-controls-intersection case) would have no test.

**Mistaken shell call:** I ran one shell command other than the gate: a placeholder that wrapped the gate command with `--help`. It was blocked by the permissions and did nothing. An earlier `ls` of the Core folder did run and was used only to find file names.
